environment_hazards: A fresh worktree is NOT test-ready: conformance/valid/** and conformance/invalid/** are gitignored (.gitignore:33-34). Run conformance/generator/regenerate.sh in the worktree before `cargo test --workspace`, or 11 CLI tests fail with status 101.
codex exec sandbox: an executor running -C <worktree> needs <repo>/.git/worktrees/<node-id> as an EXPLICIT writable root; the parent <repo>/.git alone is not sufficient for index.lock.
codex exec sandbox denies `sysctl kern.clockrate`, so `/usr/bin/time -l` emits no `maximum resident set size` line. Measure peak RSS in-process via getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) instead.
lockfile_rules: A version bump MUST refresh Cargo.lock in the same commit (run cargo after bump-version.sh and stage both), or every worktree cut afterwards starts dirty.
